meta.title: Apply for Short Term Medical Coverage | Isaac Plans
meta.description: Start your short term medical application online — coverage can begin in days, not months. Secure, guided, and only a few minutes.
meta.imageAlt: Apply for short term medical coverage with Isaac Plans

hero.title: Coverage that can start in days, not months
hero.subtitle: Bridge the gap between jobs, plans, or enrollment periods. Start your secure application online — it only takes a few minutes.

benefits.title: Coverage without the wait
benefits.desc: You don't need an open enrollment period. Apply today and your plan can begin within days.

benefits.title: Choose how long you need it
benefits.desc: Pick a term that matches your gap — from a single month up to the maximum your state allows.

benefits.title: Large provider networks
benefits.desc: Most plans use nationwide PPO networks, so you can keep seeing doctors close to home.

benefits.title: Bilingual, licensed support
benefits.desc: Get help in English or Spanish from a licensed advisor at every step.

steps.title: Open your secure application
steps.desc: Tap Apply now and your private application opens immediately — no account, no password. Come back on this device anytime to pick up where you left off.

steps.title: Fill out the secure form
steps.desc: Answer a few guided questions about you and anyone else you want covered. Everything is encrypted and saves automatically as you go.

steps.title: We review and reach out
steps.desc: Once you submit, we review your application and contact you to confirm your start date and finalize your plan.

shortTermMedicalApply.secureNote: Your information is encrypted and never shared. This process is 100% secure.
shortTermMedicalApply.ctaNote: No account or password needed — your progress saves automatically as you go.
